description: Cache Coffee & More is a locally owned coffee shop, cafe and small-batch roastery in Logan, Utah, selling its own roasted coffee direct to consumers, with a brand-direct affiliate program that explicitly recruits content creators, podcasters and social influencers.

evidence.summary: Cache Coffee's own affiliate page, fetched first-hand, publishes a 10% commission on every referred sale and states the cap explicitly three times: 'No cap', 'No Earnings Cap' in the program stats, and the FAQ answer '10% of every sale your referral link generates. No cap on earnings.' — so commission_cap is uncapped. The page also publishes a 30-day cookie, free manual-review application, payouts by PayPal, Venmo or bank transfer, and says no large following is needed. No creator-count data is published, so creator_saturation is unknown.
